items.title: Frank Capp interviewed by Monk Rowe, Los Angeles, California, September 3, 1995
items.q: last night I went down and did a set with Terry Gibbs and Buddy DeFranco down at the other hotel.

ctx.x: Yeah. I enjoy it very much. I love working with my band, but I love working with a lot of other bands, as you just mentioned, this weekend is pretty busy with me. And tomorrow I’m going to be down at the Marriott where there’s another jazz party going on with Terry Gibbs Dream Band. And then tonight I’m going up to Santa Barbara to do a

concert with Supersax. Now Med Flory has added a brass section to Supersax, and four voices. So it’s now the L.A. Voices he calls it. Sue Raney is the lead singer and the brass section, so it’s kind of, what do you call it, Supersax with voices? Or, I don’t know, it doesn’t matter what it’s called, it’s still big band and it’s fun to do. I like all kinds of playing. I enjoy doing what we’re doing here at this and I’m playing, I just finished, as I said, last night I went down and did a set with Terry Gibbs and…
You’ve got to change hats from one day to the next.
